title: Authoritative research job policy
description: Created and retained by the controller after authentication and entitlement checks.

user_subject.description: Server-derived dashboard submitter (exact verified iss, sub); never a browser or OpenShell gateway subject.

public_research_brief.description: Server-approved brief for the public stage of a combined job.

public_brief_approval_ref.description: Opaque reference to the server-side approval or DLP decision.

source_partitions.description: Trusted partition plan for private retrieval. Each partition is one source connection and resource, or an explicitly approved shared authorization domain. Admission verifies exact coverage and freezes private partition/source scopes and brief bytes before the first private read; later in-job revisions may only narrow them or add reviewed typed transfers. Expansion needs a new job.

research_brief.description: Destination-approved exact brief bytes fixed before the first private source read; a worker-derived or later revised brief cannot enter a standard retrieval attempt.

brief_approval_ref.description: Opaque reference to a trusted decision binding the exact brief digest, destination partition, and approver.

shared_authorization_domain_ref.description: Source-owner approval that all resources in this partition share one authorization and data-flow domain. Required when the source has multiple resource IDs.

cross_partition_transfer_grants.description: Explicit trusted grants for typed correlation-key transfer; an empty array denies all private cross-partition transfer.

grant_id.description: Server-generated globally never-reused ID. Admission and every later key/dispatch gate require a matching durable transfer_grant_created event in the independent authorization ledger; a tombstone always denies.

max_keys.description: Maximum key-ID issuance reservations under this grant across broker replicas and restores; the independent authorization ledger enforces the monotonic count.

max_total_bytes.description: Maximum summed canonical key-value bytes reserved for this grant in the independent authorization ledger, not a response-size cap.

max_destination_calls.description: Hard total of source B dispatch reservations across all issued keys, broker replicas, and retries for this grant. The independent authorization ledger atomically charges a per-grant reservation before dispatch and does not refund ambiguous or failed calls; its history survives broker PITR.

approval_ref.description: Opaque trusted ID of an authenticated, tamper-evident decision set binding the exact grant scope: A-side source export/declassification authority plus B-side destination resource/template acceptance authority, actors, limits, and expiry. A B owner alone cannot approve A export.

approved_at.description: Time when both required approval decisions were durably recorded.

model_route.description: Server-held alias resolved and enforced by a trusted model request gate; OpenShell v0.1.5 native provider attachment alone does not select the model.

max_model_requests.description: Hard cumulative model request count reserved atomically by the trusted model gate across stages, attempts, retries, and restore.
